strings.subtitle: — Kaiwhakangaro kōnae —
strings.dnd_hint: (rānei tōia mai he kōnae ki tēnei matapihi)
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kāore e wātea ana te tō me te tuku. Whakamahia te pātene o raro.
strings.shred_button: W H A K A N G A R O
strings.ssd_warning:
Kia tūpato! I runga i te SSD, kāore te tikanga tuhituhi i runga e whakapūmau ana i te whakangaromanga nā TRIM.
Mā te HDD tēnei hōtaka.
strings.confirm_text:
Ka tuhia te kōnae "{name}" ki runga, ā, ka mukua.

Haere tonu?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.error_cannot_read:
Kāore e taea te pānui i te kōnae:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  KUA TUHIA TE KŌNAE KI RUNGA, KUA MUKUA
strings.report_limits:
• Kāore ngā rerenga raraunga kē o NTFS (ADS) e whakahaerehia.
• Kāore te pukapuka USN e whakapaingia.
• Ngā tārua atarangi me ngā tukutahi kapua
  (OneDrive, aha atu) kāore e pāngia.
strings.step_delete: Muku mā te hipa i te ipu para
strings.status_full: Kua tuhia katoatia te ihirangi ki runga ki te kore. Kāore e taea te whakahoki — ka kite noa ngā taputapu i te kore.
strings.status_fast: Kua tuhia te mātenga, te hiku me ngā whārangi 4 MB ki runga. Ko te toenga kāore i pāngia, engari nā ngā āputa, kāore e taea e ngā taputapu kaihoko te whakahoki katoa. Mō ngā tuhinga matatapu, whakamahia te aronga KĪ.
strings.status_empty: He kore te kōnae, kāore i hiahiatia te tuhituhi ki runga. Kua mukua.
strings.error_permission: Kāore e taea te uru atu ki te kōnae. Tērā pea kua tuwhera i tētahi atu hōtaka. Katia, kātahi whakamātau anō.
strings.error_not_found: Kāore i kitea te kōnae. Tērā pea kua mukua kētia.
strings.error_is_symlink: He hononga tohu tēnei. Kāore e taea ngā hononga te whakangaro — ka noho ora tonu te kōnae whāinga.
strings.error_reparse: He kōnae wāhi tēnei (OneDrive, aha atu rānei). Kei te kapua ōna raraunga, kāore i te kōpae — kāore he mea hei whakangaro i konei.
strings.error_not_file: Ehara tēnei i te kōnae (he kōpaki, he aha atu rānei). Tukuna he kōnae.
strings.error_hardlinks: He hononga mārō anō tō tēnei kōnae ({n} katoa). Kāore he matua o ngā hononga mārō — he ōrite ngā ingoa katoa. Ki te whakangaro mā te ara o nāianei, ka tuhia ngā raraunga ki runga, ka tapahia ki te 32 paita, engari ka wātea tonu te toenga mā ētahi atu hononga. Mukua katoatia ngā hononga i te tuatahi.
strings.error_compressed:
Kua kōpeketia, kua whakamunatia, kua tūhāhā rānei te kōnae. Kāore te tuhituhi ki runga ki te kore e whakapūmau ana i te whakangaromanga o ngā raraunga tawhito nā te mea he rerekē te tiaki a NTFS.

Tangohia te huanga: pāwhiri matau → Ngā āhuatanga → Arā atu anō → tangohia te tohu o "Kōpeke" me/ranei "Whakamuna". Kātahi whakahaerehia anō a SHREDDER.
